messages:
ashok: FYI eu-west-5 dedicated pool showing partial network isolation on ~10% of pods, TCP egress flaps -> nodes marked Unreachable by kube for ~45s. Observed GPU scheduling backlog & queue growth. :warning:
maria: seeing increased queue depth on dedicated-gpu-eu-west-5, right. Which shards impacted?
ashok: org-shards: org-23, org-78 primarily. low-priority orgs first but some mid-tier hit due to preemption. Metrics: gpu_util 98%, backlog_tokens 2.3M, tail_latency 1200ms.
monitoring-bot: Alert: dedicated-eu-west-5-network-degradation triggered at 2024-11-18T09:12:01Z — Severity: P2
jamie: are we auto-evicting pods? what's the fallback policy?
ashok: autoscaler is evicting low-priority BATCH jobs but not best-effort SGL. Plan: shift traffic weights away from dedicated eu-west-5 and route high-priority orgs to hosted; throttle low-priority orgs with 30% token rate cap. Need ops approval for immediate weight override.
leo: runbook step 4 covers weight override. Command:
```
curl -X POST https://control-plane/api/v1/routes/weights -d '{"region":"eu-west-5","shift":"hosted","weights":{"hosted":0.65,"dedicated":0.35}}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"
```
maria: can we do progressive ramp? don't want cache warmup blowup for hosted.
ashok: yes - we'll do 20% increments every 90s, pre-warm hosted kv-cache for impacted model families (mistral-7b, redwood-alpha).
ops-bot: Executing pre-warm job: prewarm-eu-west-5-20241118-01 (queued)
jamie: cost note — hosted will increase billing. estimated extra = +$1.2k/hr if we route 60% of org-78 to hosted. agree to proceed?
sre-lead: approve. prioritize org-78 & org-23, throttle everything else to 25% of baseline. also enable canary fallback for control-plane route health checks.
ashok: rolling now: +20% -> hosted (20/80). initiating cache prewarm for mistral-7b.
maria: observing successful KV population on hosted nodes, 150ms cache hit latency.
ashok: after 3rd increment hosted latency stable at 230ms p95, tail latency for dedicated nodes spiking down. queue depth dropping.
leo: leaving a manual switch window open for 15m in case network isolation recovers. if dedicated nodes recover, we'll re-weigh back 10%/step.
jamie: postmortem action: investigate asymmetric egress routes on eu-west-5 fabric — possible upstream router flapping. assign to net-infra.
ashok: noting cost center tag: INCIDENT-2024-11-EUW5, file a chargeback for temporary hosted usage.
monitoring-bot: all clear? still 3 nodes Unreachable intermittently, but routing stable.
maria: summary — incident handled via priority backfill to hosted + throttles, watch for recurrence. I'll open an incident tracker ticket.
ashok: thanks. everyone on standby for 30m. :thumbsup:
